items.title: ISRG Wins EU Nod to Expand da Vinci SP in Gynecologic Procedures
items.summary: Intuitive Surgical's CE mark expands da Vinci SP into transvaginal gynecology in Europe, opening a new women's health opportunity and growth runway.

items.summary: BD expands U.S. pharmacy automation with Vmax 160 at Fairview to handle complex specialty and refrigerated medications.

items.title: ISRG's da Vinci Study Shows Better Outcomes Across 13 Common Conditions
items.summary: Intuitive Surgical's da Vinci meta-analysis across 14 million procedures found better perioperative outcomes versus laparoscopic and open surgery.

items.title: Here's Why You Should Retain DexCom Stock in Your Portfolio for Now

items.title: BLCO Gains European CE Mark for Next-Gen SeeLyra Femtosecond Laser
items.summary: Bausch + Lomb gains European CE Mark approval for SeeLyra, expanding its surgical portfolio with a compact laser platform for cataract and corneal procedures.

items.title: Revvity to Acquire Human Cell Design to Boost Metabolic Discovery
items.summary: RVTY's HCD deal is expected to add human pancreatic beta cell models, expanding drug discovery and preclinical research tools for metabolic diseases.
